figure.title: The larger absolute gap for Women+ depends on the comparison
figure.description: Right of zero: the user–nonuser difference is larger for Women+. Left of zero: it is larger for Men+.
figure.x_label: Women+ gap minus Men+ gap (percentage points)
figure.footnote: Outcome: daily or several-times-a-week unpaid job work. Each estimate subtracts the Men+ user–nonuser difference from the Women+ difference. All 20,538 employees are included except in the education common-mix comparison, which retains 20,413 and 99.4% of survey weight. These comparisons describe different targets, not causal effects. Common-mix estimates use some sparse groups. Pointwise 95% intervals use all 1,000 shared bootstrap replicates; sample sizes count unweighted respondents.
